query: SELECT f.series_id, cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT unnest(f.feature_ids) INTERSECT SELECT unnest($1::int[]))) ::int8 AS "shared!" FROM series_features f JOIN series_prior p ON p.series_id = f.series_id AND p.recommendable JOIN series s ON s.id = f.series_id AND (NOT s.adult_gated OR $3) WHERE f.feature_ids && $1::int[] AND NOT (f.series_id = ANY($2)) ORDER BY "shared!" DESC, f.series_id LIMIT $4
